title: Surrounded Regions

content.problemStatement:
You're given a grid where each cell is 0 (open) or 1 (wall). Any group of connected open cells (connected horizontally or vertically) that touches the border of the grid is considered safe.

**Capture every surrounded region, meaning every group of open cells that never touches the border gets changed to walls (1), and return the resulting grid.**
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]

sampleTestCases.explanation: the open cells at (1,1),(1,2),(2,2) form a region that never touches the border, so they get captured; the open cell at (3,1) is on the border, so it stays open
every open cell touches the border, so nothing is captured
the single open cell in the center never touches the border, so it gets captured

hints: Can sorting the array simplify the problem, or does sorting take too long compared to a hash table lookup?
Consider two-pointer approaches if the array is sorted, or a sliding window if looking for contiguous subarrays.
Prefix sums or prefix XORs can answer range sum queries in O(1) time after O(N) preprocessing.
